[[File:AnakinSkywalker-SWBC52cvr.png|thumb|250px|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], Warrior of the Infinite]]
{{Quote|There seem to be no limits to this remarkable young man, Jedi Skywalker has already rightly earned the title 'Hero With No Fear' in his exploits in battle. He is an unparalled leader and a pilot without equal.|[[Unidentified Rajah]], awarding the title of ''Warrior of the Infinite'' to Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="HNN 15:01:03">{{InsiderCite|72|Republic HoloNet News Core Edition 15:01:03}}</ref>}}
The '''Warrior of the Infinite''' was an extraordinary honor bestowed by the [[Rajah]] of the [[Virujansi/Legends|Virujansi]] that a warrior could only earn in battle.<ref name="HNN 15:01:03" />

In the 6,000 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Palace of Splendid Harmony]], only 29 individuals were elevated to this [[Military rank/Legends|rank]]. One of them was [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], who earned the title during the three years that he fought in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="HNN 15:01:03" />
